text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle asks me to watch her dance
practice.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Let's get this show on the road! Ready to
dance,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ya sure are! It's no fun dancin' solo!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Good to go? I'm starting the music!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Caught off guard, I find myself dancing
with
Taiki...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It's so much fun dancin' with ya,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You okay? You seem a little tuckered
out.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You okay? You seem a little tuckered
out.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really? Sounds good to me! I'd love
to keep
dancin' with ya!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
This here studio is our very own dance
floor! Ain't
nobody gonna get in our
way!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm puttin' the music back on! So let's
kick up our
heels! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We continue to dance right up until the
final
school bell chimes.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, did I jump the gun? Sorry 'bout that!
All right,
this time we'll take it nice and
slow!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Try to follow my lead, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... First of all, ya gotta lift your
arms like
this...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Walking me through the choreography
seems to
aid in Taiki Shuttle's own
improvement as well.
